SRC-116:R001.text: TARGET A / P0-1: A selected live audit must be stoppable from the Audit Runs panel. Pre-START reads CANCEL, live post-START reads STOP, post-START BLOCKED keeps FORCE UNBLOCK, terminal runs have no stop action. STOP routes through AuditRunCoordinator.abandon(dispatch_id, 'operator stopped active audit from Audit Runs panel'), ends terminal FAILED/operator_abandoned, frees the lane, never re-leases the dispatch, starts no fresh audit and no further waves, and refreshes immediately with visible success. The race fix: abandon() honours the terminal state returned by the bridge and never rewrites an already-COMPLETE intent to FAILED. cancel_job() is not weakened. A post-STOP run is never labelled CANCELLED.
